features.name: Pack skills in the repos' shared parent; uninstall removes pack links
features.description: Follow-ups to feat-090. A session started in the folder above the repos (~/projects) loaded no pack skills, since agents read skills from the folder the session starts in. sync-all now links the union of the registered repos' packs into their shared parent, unless that folder is at or above HOME, the filesystem root, or inside a git repo. uninstall.sh runs `harness_adapter.py unlink-packs --agent A` per agent: it removes that agent's stored pack skills and every repo or parent link into them, and rewrites each repo's .git/info/exclude block to the links that remain.
acceptance_criteria: sync-all links every listed pack into the shared parent and drops packs no repo lists any more
nothing is linked when the shared parent is HOME or inside a git repo
unlink-packs removes one agent's store and only the links into it, and updates the exclude block
live: claude and agy started in ~/projects see a pack skill
all 11 harness gates pass, with gate output saved to a file
features.verification: python3 -m pytest tests/test_harness_adapter.py -q && bash scripts/tests/test_uninstall_globals.sh && bash scripts/harness-verify.sh
features.evidence: Tests first: the shared-parent test failed (no links), the unlink test failed (no function); 43 passed after. Mutations: dropping the HOME check and dropping the git check each fail one case. Real sync-all linked ai-stack, kanban-ai, linear and webapp-testing into ~/projects/.claude/skills, .agents/skills and .kiro/skills; live claude -p (haiku) and agy -p started in ~/projects answer YES for linear (both NO before). test_uninstall_globals.sh passes (fake HOME). harness-verify.sh: all 11 gates passed, output saved to a file. Same round, outside this feature: atelier's Stop block fixed in atelier 0413080 (lockfile-only update of undici, js-yaml, brace-expansion, browserslist; two react-router advisories recorded as not applicable until 2027-01-18 in apps/firstdigital/osv-scanner.toml, since 6.x has no fix; typecheck, 12 tests, build and ./init.sh pass). Not done: deploying the global rules and editing agents/engineering-rules.md were both denied by the auto-mode classifier as self-modification; the owner applies them.
